name: Queen Mira Valen
summary: Thirty-one years inside Caerlyn. She knows the corridors better than the men who want her gone.

epilogue.loyal: Mira keeps the keys and sleeps no better for it.
epilogue.warm: Mira remains in the castle, useful and untrusted.
epilogue.cold: Mira withdraws into the royal rooms and lets the court invent her.
epilogue.dead: Mira is buried without the public viewing she denied her husband.
epilogue.missing: Mira is not found. The seal is.
epilogue.captured: Mira is a prisoner in her own castle.

name: Ethan Valen
summary: Erol's younger brother. Once the most trusted soldier in Nezrel. Then a name people were told not to say.

epilogue.loyal: Ethan stands where he is asked and does not enjoy it.
epilogue.warm: Ethan advises, then rides out to see if the roads are honest.
epilogue.cold: Ethan will not enter Caerlyn again.
epilogue.dead: Ethan dies with a sword in his hand and the accusation still unanswered.
epilogue.missing: Ethan vanishes the way he did six years ago.
epilogue.captured: Ethan is chained, which will make a worse story than killing him.

name: Arlo
summary: Raised by House Maren and never quite of it. The horses know him. The court does not.

epilogue.loyal: Arlo learns the castle by getting lost in it.
epilogue.warm: Arlo keeps a horse saddled, in case the crown was a mistake.
epilogue.cold: Arlo goes back to the vale and will not discuss kings.
epilogue.dead: Arlo dies before most of Nezrel agrees he was anybody.
epilogue.missing: Arlo is gone. The ledger of payments is not.
epilogue.captured: Arlo is held as a bastard, a hostage, or both.

name: Lord Alistair Storm
summary: He has ruled the North since he was seventeen. He thinks most people cannot be trusted with quiet.

epilogue.loyal: Alistair enforces the peace and calls that mercy.
epilogue.warm: Alistair keeps the North and sends iron south on his own terms.
epilogue.cold: Alistair returns to Stormhold and bars the gate.
epilogue.dead: Stormhold flies a black banner. The North does not bend. It also does not forget.
epilogue.missing: Alistair is not among the dead they counted.
epilogue.captured: A northern lord in a southern cell is a story that starts wars.

name: Captain Garran Vale
summary: Owes his career to Ethan and his post to Mira. Honour has not offered him a clean order.

epilogue.loyal: Garran keeps the gate and sleeps badly, which is how he shows love.
epilogue.warm: Garran stays, though he will not toast either of his oaths.
epilogue.cold: Garran resigns the Guard and will not say whose name he failed.
epilogue.dead: The Guard cuts Garran's name into the roll and does not speak it at supper.
epilogue.missing: Garran leaves his sword on the table.
epilogue.captured: Without Garran the inner doors feel theoretical.

name: Lady Celene Veyne
summary: Widowed, precise, and uninterested in who wears the crown so long as ships still move.

epilogue.loyal: Celene's tariffs arrive on time. Her warnings arrive earlier.
epilogue.warm: Celene keeps the ports open and her opinion shut.
epilogue.cold: Celene prices your reign the way she prices grain.
epilogue.dead: The coast does not mourn loudly. It raises prices.
epilogue.missing: Celene's captains say she is inspecting a warehouse. They smile.
epilogue.captured: Holding Celene is a good way to discover how fast a city can starve.

name: Master Oren Pell
summary: He knows the illness and the last night. Erol made him swear, and Pell is the sort of man a swear sticks to.

epilogue.loyal: Pell remains at court and answers fewer questions than he is asked.
epilogue.warm: Pell will speak, a little, if the room is small.
epilogue.cold: Pell leaves the city with his notes burned.
epilogue.dead: The only physician who could have settled the death is dead himself.
epilogue.missing: Pell is no longer in the royal rooms.
epilogue.captured: Men are already inventing the confession they want from him.

name: Nessa Grey
summary: She saw Mira with the king's medicine and vanished before anyone could put her under oath.

epilogue.loyal: Nessa lives under a new name and still flinches at bells.
epilogue.warm: Nessa tells what she saw and then asks to be forgotten.
epilogue.cold: Nessa will not come to Caerlyn for any crown.
epilogue.dead: The last witness of the bedchamber is gone.
epilogue.missing: Nessa is still missing. So is the testament.
epilogue.captured: Everyone wants Nessa. That is not the same as keeping her safe.

name: Marshal Bren Tal
summary: Twenty thousand soldiers swore to the Crown, not to a widow, a brother, a bastard, or a northern lord. Bren is keeping that sentence intact for as long as he can.

epilogue.loyal: Bren puts the royal army in the field under your banner and looks unhappy about the relief he feels.
epilogue.warm: Bren will fight for a settled monarch and not a moment sooner.
epilogue.cold: Bren keeps the army in camp and lets the claimants spend each other.
epilogue.dead: The royal army, suddenly leaderless, becomes everyone's argument.
epilogue.missing: Bren is not at the camp. The colonels are already choosing favourites.
epilogue.captured: The largest army in Nezrel is waiting to see who holds its marshal.

name: Lord Tomas Maren
summary: He raised Arlo and has never said why the royal purse paid for the privilege. He is afraid the truth will cost the boy.

epilogue.loyal: Tomas stands in public and looks older than he did in the stable yard.
epilogue.warm: Tomas sends horses and withholds the rest of the story.
epilogue.cold: Tomas closes the vale and calls it protection.
epilogue.dead: The man who could have explained the payments dies with them.
epilogue.missing: Tomas leaves the estate to Evelyne and a locked desk.
epilogue.captured: Tomas in chains makes Arlo someone's lever.

name: Lady Evelyne Maren
summary: Arlo's mother in every way that matters. She hated Erol for using her house as a cupboard.

epilogue.loyal: Evelyne comes to court and refuses to call it an honour.
epilogue.warm: Evelyne writes sharp letters and sends food.
epilogue.cold: Evelyne tells Arlo, or whoever is listening, that the vale was enough.
epilogue.dead: The vale's temper goes into the ground with her.
epilogue.missing: Evelyne will not be found in any hall that flies a Valen banner.
epilogue.captured: Evelyne does not bargain. Her captors discover this slowly.

name: Lord Edric Edevane
summary: Charming, ambitious, and already asking what happens to House Edevane if his aunt loses.

epilogue.loyal: Edric smiles in the correct rooms and remembers who put him there.
epilogue.warm: Edric is helpful. He is also counting.
epilogue.cold: Edric has already written the letter that abandons Mira. He has not sent it.
epilogue.dead: House Edevane's cleverest head is gone. The rest of them look smaller.
epilogue.missing: Edric is visiting friends. The friends are whoever is winning.
epilogue.captured: Edric talks enough to be dangerous and not enough to be useful.

name: Father Aldren Veil
summary: He must light the Crown Candle. He is afraid of lighting it for someone who will burn the hearth down.

epilogue.loyal: Aldren lights the candle. His hand is not steady. The flame is.
epilogue.warm: Aldren prays for the realm and postpones the prayer for you.
epilogue.cold: Aldren will perform the rites and withhold the blessing that matters.
epilogue.dead: The Flame has no High Keeper, and every priest with ambition has noticed.
epilogue.missing: Aldren retreats into the temple and will not receive claimants.
epilogue.captured: A chained High Keeper makes a coronation look like a raid.

name: Lord Osric Harrow
summary: Poor, proud, and ready to bleed if it keeps House Storm out of the west.

epilogue.loyal: Osric brings longbows and an old grievance he expects you to share.
epilogue.warm: Osric fights your enemies and keeps his own accounts.
epilogue.cold: Osric remembers the old blood and not your name.
epilogue.dead: The west loses the lord who hated Storm most usefully.
epilogue.missing: Osric takes to the forest. The forest has always suited Harrow.
epilogue.captured: A Harrow in a Storm dungeon is a torch looking for a crowd.

name: Chancellor Lucan Rook
summary: He believes a stable lie is kinder than a true civil war. He keeps the papers that can prove either.

epilogue.loyal: Lucan files your reign under the heading that will be hardest to appeal.
epilogue.warm: Lucan remains useful and slightly disappointed.
epilogue.cold: Lucan serves the office and waits to see if you survive it.
epilogue.dead: The archives lose their most careful liar.
epilogue.missing: Lucan is 'consulting records' in a room no one else can find.
epilogue.captured: Whoever holds the Chancellor holds the index to the kingdom.
